model_sheet_required_poses.purpose: lock face, hair, torso, shorts, wraps and asymmetry from front
prove hair volume, back anatomy, shorts, red band side logic and lava arm side logic
lock combat guard, opponent eye-line, lava arm visibility and root stance
lock compression, raised knee, support foot, kiai face and shorts/cloth response
lock long reach, support foot, visible lava hand, open/guard hand family and attack silhouette

rejection_rules: Reject any pose where the hair becomes a different haircut instead of a tracked angle/action variation.
Reject any pose where the lava arm endpoint disappears or reads as wrap/glove.
Reject any pose where the face is blank during active strike or hurt.
Reject any pose where the red biceps band swaps side without justified occlusion.
